summary: Iter12: per-device Sound/Silent for push + employee leave-decision push. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (new test_push_employee_leave.py + updated test_web_push.py). Employees can use the push endpoints (public-key, subscribe, status, PATCH silent, test, unsubscribe). PATCH only changes your own device (404 'This phone isn't subscribed' for other users or unknown endpoints, 422 if silent is missing, 401 if not logged in). New subscriptions start with silent=false, and re-subscribing keeps the silent value. Approving or rejecting a leave sends a push to the employee's devices only, not the admin's. The fake FCM endpoint returns 410, the log shows 'Push failed (410) for user_testemp01' and the subscription is deleted. Unit tests of leave_push_payload pass (with note: '\nNote: ...', no note: ' · by <admin>', tag leave_<id>, url /leave). A leaving-area alert reaches the admin's device but not the employee's. /push/test returns 400 when there are no devices and deletes dead endpoints. Frontend (mocked Notification/PushManager/serviceWorker): the employee /leave card shows 'Leave updates on your phone' OFF. Submitting a leave shows the 'Want to know the moment it's decided?' toast. Its 'Turn on' action subscribes and refreshes the card to ON/SOUND/1 device. The sound toggle switches SOUND and SILENT, and the server silent flag follows each switch. Turn off removes the server subscription. Send test against a dead endpoint shows the 'Couldn't reach your devices' error and the card goes back to OFF. The admin card in /admin#alerts has the same sound toggle and passed the same checks. sw.js reviewed: silent true sets silent:true, no vibrate and requireInteraction false.

minor.issue: test_iter6_leave_fixes.py::test_sub_admin_cannot_decide_out_of_scope fails. The test is stale because server code says any manager can decide any leave by design. test_leave_admin_console.py::test_holiday_add_delete fails with 'A holiday already exists on this date' because of leftover test data. Neither failure involves push.

issues: The 'Turn on' offer toast stacks on top of the 'Leave request sent for approval' success toast, so the success toast is mostly hidden. Minor; consider delaying the offer by about 1.5 s.

offerPush calls currentSubscription; if the browser has a subscription that the server has already deleted (e.g. after a 410), the offer is not shown. Acceptable, because the card still shows OFF.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the mock approach from iter11, injected with add_init_script before navigation: override Notification.permission and requestPermission, and override navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration/register/ready so they return a fake reg whose pushManager has getSubscription/subscribe returning {endpoint, toJSON, unsubscribe}.
